headers.name: YPY-Cache-Expire
headers.description: Marks old the stored copies whose path or tag matches a pattern: a comma separated list of paths, globs and tags (`/reports*`, `/cart`, `*`, `tag:products`), or `false` to keep everything. An old copy is still shown at once and is always revalidated with the server, whatever its age or `max-age`. To delete a copy instead, use `YPY-Cache-Evict`.

headers.name: YPY-Cache-Evict
headers.description: Deletes the stored copies whose path or tag matches a pattern: a comma separated list of paths, globs and tags (`/reports*`, `/cart`, `*`, `tag:products`), or `false` to keep everything. The next request for a deleted copy goes to the server and waits for the answer. Without either header, a successful request that is not a GET deletes every copy.

classes.name: ypy-revalidating
classes.description: Applied to the target of a request while the extension checks with the server a copy it already showed.

attributes.name: ypy-cache
attributes.description: Keeps the response of this element's GET and shows it at once next time, then revalidates it with `If-None-Match` and `If-Modified-Since` and swaps again only when the content changed. Same origin only; `no-store` and `private` responses are never kept (`private` unless asked). `false` turns it off for the element.

values.name: false
values.description: Do not cache requests of this element.

modifiers.name: ttl:<time>
modifiers.description: A copy older than this is not shown, only revalidated. Default `10m`.

modifiers.name: fresh:<time>
modifiers.description: A copy younger than this is shown without asking the server. Default 0; the response's `max-age` wins.

modifiers.name: offline
modifiers.description: Keep the copy in `sessionStorage` and show it when the network fails.

modifiers.name: size:<n>
modifiers.description: Most copies held, least recently used first out. Default 50.

modifiers.name: bytes:<n>
modifiers.description: Most characters of response text held. Default 2097152.

attributes.name: ypy-cache-tags
attributes.description: Labels the copy of this element's request with one or more tags, so the server can expire or evict it by name (`YPY-Cache-Expire: tag:products`) without knowing the URLs. A comma or space separated list.

events.name: ypy:cache:hit
events.description: A stored copy answers the request. `age` is in ms; `offline` is true when the network failed and the copy was shown for that reason.

events.name: ypy:cache:revalidated
events.description: The check that follows a shown copy ended. `changed` is true when new content was swapped in; `status` is the status of the check.

events.name: ypy:cache:expire
events.description: Copies were marked old by a `YPY-Cache-Expire` header or `ypy.cache.expire()`. They are still shown, then revalidated. `expired` is how many.

events.name: ypy:cache:evict
events.description: Copies were deleted by a `YPY-Cache-Evict` header, the default after a successful non-GET request, `ypy.cache.evict()` or `ypy.cache.clear()`. `removed` is how many.

config.name: cache
config.description: Defaults for `ypy-cache`; the attribute overrides them per element.

config.name: cache.all
config.description: Cache every GET of the page, not only the elements with `ypy-cache`.

config.name: cache.ttl
config.description: A copy older than this is not shown, only revalidated.

config.name: cache.fresh
config.description: A copy younger than this is shown without asking the server.

config.name: cache.offline
config.description: Keep copies in `sessionStorage` and show them when the network fails.

config.name: cache.bytes
config.description: Most characters of response text held.
